description: Migration fallback for unrecognized legacy items.
_migrationNote: Use this ID for unknown items during legacy migration; replace with real IDs when identified

name: Cigarette
description: Trade blood for calm. Tap repeatedly, but don’t bottom out.

name: Radio Transceiver
description: Encrypted communication device.

name: Surveillance Cam
description: Compact surveillance camera.

name: Personal Journal
description: Your operational notes and observations.

name: 3D Printer
description: Consumes itself to print extra action cards when you spend ammo/battery. Mostly prints lower-quality substitutes.

name: Pickpocket Gloves
description: Lets you pickpocket exposed enemy cards when adjacent, or plant cards into enemy empty slots. The enemy still gets angry if you fumble.

name: Scout Scope
description: See what they're holding. Equip to reveal enemy cards during combat.
_designNote: Phase 3 reveal enabler. revealTags intersect enemy card tags to determine which cards light up as interactable. Broad coverage (ranged+basic+melee+tech) makes it useful across most enemies.

name: EMP Disruptor
description: Fry their tech cards. Destroy enemy cards tagged electronic or ranged. Triggers rage.
_designNote: Phase 3 destroy enabler. Narrower tag coverage than Scout Scope — only tech/ranged/electrical. Destroy triggers enemy card_killed event (enemy goes >:( enraged). Pairs with Signal Jammer for combo disruption.

name: Wire Tap
description: Intercepted comms. One random enemy card revealed at combat start.
_designNote: Passive auto-reveal. EnemyCardInteractability.autoReveal() checks for this effect. Fires once per combat entry. Stacks with Scout Scope for more intel.

name: Rusty Key
description: An old rusted key. Equip and use near a locked gate.
_designNote: Tier 2 gate key. Goes to persistent inventory, equip to header active slot, toggle+interact to unlock.

name: Security Keycard
description: Electronic access card. Still has charge.

name: Master Key
description: Opens all standard locks.

name: Thumb Drive
description: Contains encrypted access credentials.

name: Access Card
description: Aerospace facility access card. Permits elevator use.

name: Mall Security Tag
description: Security clearance for restricted mall areas.

name: Industrial Pass
description: Worker authorization for restricted industrial zones.

name: Rusty Lockpick
description: A bent piece of metal. Single-use, but it gets the job done.
_designNote: CORRECTED: Tier 2 gate key (consumable). Unlocks WOODEN_GATE, OLD_DOOR, LOCKED_CHEST. T1 keys are resource currency (key_ammo), not items. This is a single-use gate unlocker — same tier as ITM-010 through ITM-016 but disposable.

name: Bronze Key
description: A tarnished bronze key with ornate markings.
_designNote: CORRECTED: Tier 2 gate key (consumable). Unlocks BRONZE_GATE, MUSEUM_DOOR, LOCKED_CHEST. T1 keys are resource currency (key_ammo), not items. This is a single-use gate unlocker.

name: Decoy Key
description: Looks like it should fit... but it doesn't.
_designNote: LAGM moderation item. Fake key injected by Floor Synthesis Engine to add friction. compatibleGates is empty so it never unlocks anything. Consumed on failed attempt. Tier 2 (gate key shape) but nonfunctional.

name: Cardboard Box
description: Drop on the map and step inside to hide. Enemies may walk over and destroy it. Consumed on exit.

name: Reinforced Box
description: Heavy-duty shipping crate. Better evasion and harder to destroy than a common box.

name: Tactical Box
description: Military-spec camouflage container. Rarely noticed by patrols. Survives most enemy contact.

name: Refrigerator Box
description: A legend among boxes. Enemies walk right past it. Persists even after combat. Near-perfect evasion.

name: Blacksmith's Hammer
description: A master blacksmith's hammer. Return it to the forge for a powerful reward.
_designNote: Diablo 2 Charsi quest pattern. Drops from late-game loot table, turn in to Blacksmith NPC for card upgrade gem.

name: Rune Fragment
description: A shard of crystallized power. A runesmith could fuse this into something greater.
_designNote: Stackable quest item. Turn in 3 to Runesmith for rare card upgrade. Rolls from late-game boss loot table.

name: Archive Indexer
description: Recovered Field Catalog. See every card you'll draw — but lose the chaos advantage.
_designNote: Unlocks sort, shows card faces in draw bar. Replaces shuffle. Trade-off: lose randomness upside.

name: Suppressor Oil
description: If fire played after water: cancel alert, trigger stealth bonus, draw 1 card.
_designNote: Cascade enabler. Tag-filtered: only triggers on wet+fire synergy chains.

name: Dead Drop Cache
description: When a synergy auto-resolves: draw 1 additional card, 30% chance to chain again.
_designNote: Core cascade enabler. Makes synergy builds self-sustaining. Recursive chain capped at 5 depth.

name: Tripwire Array
description: If enemy skips turn: gain 1 Focus, draw 1 card.
_designNote: Reactive cascade enabler. Pairs with stun/skip synergies for focus generation loops.

name: Signal Jammer
description: If 2+ cards auto-resolve this turn: enemy loses next turn (50%). Stacks with Bump Stock.
_designNote: Multi-resolve cascade enabler. Rewards synergy-heavy turns with control. 50% roll prevents guaranteed lockout.

name: Magnet
description: Nearby currency and ammo fly to you. Walk past, don't stop.
_designNote: Post-combat scatter QoL. Base range 3 tiles (Chebyshev). Upgrade extends to 5 and adds loose item collection.

name: Magnet+
description: Powerful attraction field. Currency, ammo, and loose items pulled from 5 tiles.
_designNote: Upgraded magnet. Also pulls loose card/item drops. Staggered collection (250ms intervals) for visual satisfaction.

name: Cargo Webbing
description: Disposable escape items sometimes survive use. 35% save rate.
_designNote: Prevents one-time-use flight cards (Smoke Bomb Mk0, Chaff Flare) from being consumed on play. Save rate scales with card quality. Does not affect Cyanide Capsule (already reusable). Upgrade: Tactical Harness (60% rate + items).

name: Tactical Harness
description: Escape items rarely break. 60% flight save, 20% save on all disposables.
_designNote: Upgraded Cargo Webbing. Higher flight-card save rate plus a small chance to save ANY disposable card (grenades, etc). Save rate stacks with card quality bonuses.

name: Thermal Goggles
description: Heat signatures cut through darkness. Reveal all enemy cards + accuracy/stealth bonus in dark tiles.
_designNote: Epic-tier reveal + darkness synergy. Broadest revealTags coverage (reveals nearly everything). darkness_accuracy_bonus and stealth_in_darkness_bonus reward players who stay in low-ambient tiles. Ties directly into the lowered biome ambient lighting — makes darkness a strategic advantage instead of a handicap.

name: Surge Protector
description: Feedback Burn self-damage halved. 20% chance electrical cards don't consume battery.
_designNote: Passive counterplay item. Halves the Feedback Burn tag risk for electrical overcommit. Also 20% battery save — makes electrical chains more sustainable. Pairs with Thermal Stabilizer (stolen) for full electrical immunity.

name: Concealment Network
description: Exposure Risk threshold increased by 1. 30% chance to resist forced reveal.
_designNote: Passive counterplay item. Raises Covert Exposure Risk threshold from 3 to 4 (one more stealth card before blowing cover). 30% resist forced reveals (Counter-Intel Sweep, enemy detection). Lets stealth builds go deeper without getting punished.

name: Recoil Dampener
description: Overexertion fatigue halved. 25% chance ballistic cards don't add fatigue.
_designNote: Passive counterplay item. Halves Overexertion fatigue from ballistic overcommit. 25% fatigue save on all ballistic plays. Lets Overkill chains extend into triple-🟥 territory safely.

name: Burnt Contacts
description: Heat Score threshold raised by 1. Black Market cards reduce alert by 2 instead of raising it.
_designNote: Passive counterplay item. Raises Black Market Heat Score threshold from 2 to 3. Each Black Market card now REDUCES alert by 2 (your contacts cover your tracks). Flips the risk profile — Black Market becomes safer but still dangerous at 3+. The 'deep cover agent' item.

name: Bandolier
description: 30% chance spent resources refund when a disposable card is consumed. Burn cards, get ammo back.
_designNote: Core disposable-as-ammo enabler. When any consumesOnPlay card is consumed, 30% chance the resource it cost (ammo or battery) is refunded. Chaff Flare (1 ammo) → 30% free. Sabotage (1 battery) → 30% free. Stacks with Expendable Ordnance combo refund for near-guaranteed ammo return on ballistic disposables. The 'reload belt' fantasy.

name: Demolition Vest
description: Disposable cards explode on exit. Ballistic/explosive: 3 splash. All others: 1 splash. Everything is a grenade.
_designNote: Turns EVERY disposable card into a grenade. Ballistic/explosive disposables (Exploding Cufflink, Flashbang) deal 3 AoE splash on consumption. ALL other disposables deal 1 splash. Pairs with Expendable Ordnance for +4 damage + 3 splash + ammo refund from a single Exploding Cufflink play. The Michael Bay item — everything explodes.

name: Recycler
description: Disposable cards sometimes survive. Save rate scales with card rarity: common 20%, uncommon 30%, rare 40%.
_designNote: THE 'item quality matters' item. Higher rarity disposable cards are more likely to survive consumption. Common junk (Fumbled Grab, Smoke Bomb) = 20% save. Uncommon utility (Sabotage, Recon Scan, Camera Flash) = 30%. Rare finishers (Exploding Cufflink, Violin Wire) = 40%. This is the quality-scales-with-rarity loop the user asked for. Upgraded Cargo Webbing for combat disposables (Cargo Webbing only saves flight cards). Pairs with Demolition Vest: even if Recycler saves the card, the splash still fires.

name: Pattern Lens
description: See momentum counters on enemy cards. Auto-reveal cards at Momentum 3+.
_designNote: Phase 5 Information Duel clarity item. Makes momentum dots visible and auto-reveals enemy cards that reach Momentum 3+, letting the player see the pattern developing. Doesn't grant extra interactions — just information. See the rhythm, don't control it.

name: Dampener Coil
description: Reduce Overload damage by 15%. Escalation clock ticks slower (+1 grace turn).
_designNote: Phase 5 survivability relic. Mitigates but doesn't eliminate Overload spikes. The escalation slow gives 1 extra turn before payoff damage kicks in. Paired with Pattern Lens: see the pattern coming, survive the spike, then counter.

name: Precision Tools
description: Destroying Payoff-role cards reduces Rage spike by 1. +1 disruption bonus from momentum.
_designNote: Phase 5 precision relic. Surgical players who target Payoff-role slots (the finisher in Anchor→Fuel→Payoff) take less Rage backlash. Also boosts momentum-based disruption bonus. Rewards pattern reading + precise targeting. The scalpel item.

name: Scrambler Chip
description: Gain +1 interaction charge per turn. Two shots at the enemy's hand.
_designNote: Phase 5 interaction economy item. Epic rarity because 2 charges/turn fundamentally changes the duel — you can reveal THEN steal on the same turn, or destroy two cards. Very strong but costs the passive slot. The keystone item for heavy-interaction builds.

name: Auto Sears
description: Full auto. Swipe cards to push-resolve them instantly.

name: Bump Stock
description: Swipe attack cards for immediate push rounds.

name: Redneck Obliterator
description: Instant resolve on tap. Swipe to push-resolve directionally.

name: Proximity Sensor
description: Extends enemy capsule visibility by 2 tiles. See their cards from further away.
_designNote: ENI Phase 1 enabler. Default capsule visibility is 4 tiles; this bumps it to 6. Passive slot — opportunity cost is giving up a combat passive. Low risk, information-only benefit.

name: Patience Module
description: Idle near enemies to reveal their hand 50% faster. Patience rewarded.
_designNote: ENI Phase 1 enabler. Reduces the idle-reveal timer by 50%. Stacks conceptually with proximity — stand close AND idle to reveal their deck. Encourages slow, stealthy play.

name: Long Arm
description: Steal and plant from 2 tiles away instead of adjacent. Long arms, light fingers.
_designNote: ENI Phase 2 enabler. Extends steal/plant adjacency requirement from 1 to 2 tiles (Manhattan). Rare rarity — this is powerful because it lets you interact without being in the enemy's immediate detection zone. Requires Pickpocket Gloves still equipped in active slot.

name: Ghost Echo
description: See enemy hands from across the room. Idle reveal is lightning fast. Enemies barely notice your theft.
_designNote: ENI combined enabler. Epic-tier capstone for card manipulation builds. +4 tile capsule range (total 8), 75% faster idle reveal, and only 10% suspicion chance after steal (down from 20%). The endgame passive for a pure thief build. Competes with combat passives for the slot.

name: Skeleton Keyring
description: A jangling ring of skeleton picks. Passively reduces key_ammo spent on NCH theft actions by 1 (PICKPOCKET/STEAL become free, SWAP costs 1 instead of 2). Grants +1 key_ammo resource at each floor start.
_designNote: ENI Phase 0 key_ammo RESOURCE mitigation. NOT a key item — this is a passive equipment that reduces the key_ammo currency cost of THEFT_MECHANICS §6 interactions. T1 keys are a resource tracked in GAMESTATE.keys.ammo and displayed in debrief feed (#FF8A3D). This item lowers the resource spend, not the item count. Competes with combat passives for the slot.

name: Wax Impression Kit
description: Soft wax block and mould frame. Use to gain +2 key_ammo resource instantly. Enough for 2 steals or 1 swap.
_designNote: ENI Phase 0 key_ammo RESOURCE grant. Consumable that adds 2 to GAMESTATE.keys.ammo (the T1 key currency pool, NOT an inventory item). Found in breakables or shop. Pairs with Skeleton Keyring for a full thief economy build. THEFT_MECHANICS §6 alignment.

name: Fool's Reward
description: Glitters like gold but crumbles to dust. A deceptive prize.
_designNote: LAGM moderation item. Deceptive reward injected by pace controls to punish overconfident speed-runners. Looks like a valuable rare drop but applies negative effects on pickup/use.

name: They Live Glasses
description: You see the world as it truly is. The next floor's veil lifts — and the one after.
_designNote: Player-driven manipulation item (SEED_DESIGN §5.1). Extends mutable floor window to F+2 (param-only). Window can collapse based on time, player actions, or energy drain. Activates futureVision player state.

name: Winston Smith's Diary
description: The pages rewrite themselves. Futures flicker, paths fork, and the watchers lose their grip.
_designNote: Player-driven manipulation item (SEED_DESIGN §5.2). Counter-item to They Live Glasses. Injects entropy into floor resolution — M-Console sees mutation fog, conflicting branches, flickering templates, delayed seed resolution, ghost acks. Activates entropyField player state with sourceItemId 'winston_diary'.

name: Flipper Zero
description: Compact multi-tool radio. Grants 1-5 key_ammo at each floor start (quality varies by signal strength). Your skeleton key to the airwaves.
_designNote: ENI Phase 0 primary key_ammo mitigation. Guaranteed drop from tutorial floor 0 Supply Crate near ancient snail. The 1-5 range uses seedrandom(floorSeed + 'flipper') so the grant is deterministic per floor but varies run-to-run. Average 3/floor over 5 floors. Competes with combat passives for passive slot. BLOCKED by ITEM_DROP_PIPELINE_ROADMAP.md Phases 1-3 (breakable→pickup pipeline not yet built).

name: Magnifying Glass
description: Standard-issue field lens. Reveals hidden details when dragged across surfaces. Persistent across all platforms.
_designNote: Platform proof-of-concept item (ITM-200 range = cross-platform persistent). Seeded in every new account localStorage, rolls into authenticated inventory on login. Bridges ARG live missions → item designer portal → shared persistent inventory → Gone Rogue deployment. In /games and terminal inventory: click+drag activates porthole lens overlay (PORTHOLE_PUZZLE_TOOLKIT.md §4). In Gone Rogue: acts as draw modifier (magnifying-glass mode via card-state-authority.js detection).

name: Cypher Note
description: Torn page from the field manual. Contains a section of the pigpen cipher key. Collect all 4 to decode intercepted messages.
_designNote: Platform item (ITM-201). Cypher Note series — 4 collectible pages forming a complete pigpen cipher key (Notes 0-3: grid A-I, X J-M, grid N-V, X W-Z). Hidden in /games inventory; revealed by magnifying glass drag-over. Popup shows the cipher image at native ~200px size. Each note maps to /assets/Images/Items/Cypher_Notes0-3/Cypher_Note_{index}.png.

name: Decoder Ring
description: Field-issue cipher decoder ring. Equip to activate the decoder wheels in the Puzzles section. Rotate the concentric alphabet rings to decode intercepted messages.
_designNote: Platform item (ITM-202). Seeded by default. When equipped, activates the interactive decoder ring canvas in the Puzzles category and auto-expands that section.

name: Amazon Box
description: Standard shipping box. Disposable camouflage.

name: Refrigerator Box Suit
description: Large cardboard camouflage. Better when you take your time.
